learningObjective: See why fixing the item factors makes every user-vector update independent, and fixing the user factors makes every item-vector update independent.
mediumRationale: Deterministic SVG is the smallest medium that can align the sparse matrix, both dense factor shapes, parallel row solves, and the alternating cycle in one spatial explanation. Mermaid expresses flow but not matrix dimensions or aligned parallel solves reliably. Semantic HTML could show the matrices but would make the cycle harder to trace. Interaction adds state without adding insight because the two phases are fixed. Reusing a paper figure adds licensing risk and unnecessary detail. No visual would leave the article's hardest mental model—the independence created by freezing one factor—in prose.

pages.insight: The matrix-factorization slide shows an m by n matrix decomposed through a k-dimensional subspace, but specifically frames non-negative matrix factorization rather than ALS.
This is the recommender-systems section divider; it provides topic context but no instructional figure or ALS mechanism.

The collaborative-filtering slide describes factorizing a user-rating matrix into user and item embeddings and explicitly describes fold-in as solving a user embedding while item embeddings remain fixed.

deckReview.notes: Copilot CLI agent 5 searched all 214 PDF pages for alternating least squares, least squares, collaborative filtering, matrix factorization, and implicit feedback, then inspected neighboring pages 29-31 and 129-131 directly. Page 29 covers factorization machines, page 31 is an algorithms divider, and page 131 covers content-based and hybrid recommenders; none shows ALS. Pages 30 and 130 provide relevant matrix and fixed-factor context, but no slide depicts the alternating independent solves and no deck artwork was reused.

sourceReview.notes: The shipped diagram is an original, general mathematical construction using the article's notation and established site primitives. It contains no third-party visual asset, paper-specific geometry, or empirical data; source figures were unnecessary and their reuse permissions were therefore not assumed.

agentReview.summary: Independent review identified the conditional independence of row updates—not factorization alone—as the hardest prose-only model. The final SVG couples factor dimensions to two explicitly labeled parallel phases without implying that ALS makes the joint objective convex.

implementation.accessibility: The SVG has a programmatic title and complete description. Matrix names, dimensions, numbered phases, independent systems, and cycle arrows carry all meaning without color. Existing visual-wide and visual-scroll primitives preserve readable labels at 390 CSS pixels, theme variables support light and dark modes, and the established print override removes the minimum width and forces high-contrast paper colors.
